The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-what-actually-how-9|Cloudflare Workers]] Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip provide streamlined solutions for selling digital products, but both have stringent regional restrictions. They typically offer payment processing, product delivery, and marketing tools. However, these platforms limit access to creators in countries such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, essentially locking them out of a global marketplace. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructures like COREMERCH empower creators by providing an end-to-end solution that includes hosting, payment processing, and file delivery without traditional barriers. With COREMERCH, the creators own their infrastructure and can operate freely without reliance on any restricted platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Payhip explicitly exclude certain countries, creating a significant barrier for many digital entrepreneurs. When creators from these regions try to sign up, they are met with error messages and ineligibility notices. This exclusion is not only frustrating but detrimental to their business growth. On the other hand, COREMERCH offers a sovereign commerce stack that is designed specifically for those locked out of conventional platforms. By using technologies like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, COREMERCH ensures that creators can set up their online stores regardless of their geographical location, providing a permanent alternative to the exclusionary practices of traditional payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The fees associated with platforms like PayPal can be high, combined with policies that may freeze your account for up to 180 days without appeal, which is a serious risk for creators. Gumroad's fees can also accumulate quickly, cutting into profits. In contrast, COREMERCH’s NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee on transactions and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. The payment process is immediate and doesn't involve lengthy delays or account holds. For creators looking to maximize their earnings while ensuring reliable income flow, COREMERCH’s model is not just cheaper; it's also more reliable and secure.
COREMERCH ensures you own your data and infrastructure, not just rent it.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical factor for digital creators. With platforms like Payhip and Gumroad, users do not own their data or the infrastructure on which they operate; they are renting access. This results in vulnerability to policy changes and unforeseen account suspensions. COREMERCH flips this model on its head. With its infrastructure, creators retain full ownership of their assets and data. Automated payment verification and file delivery are built-in features that ensure efficiency and reliability, allowing creators to focus on their craft while COREMERCH handles the operational aspects.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When deciding between these platforms, consider your location and the risks involved. If you live in an area excluded by traditional platforms, your choices are limited. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a robust solution that can be deployed in 48 hours, providing you with the sovereignty and control you need. By leveraging free tools like Supabase for order storage and Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, you can create a sustainable business model that isn’t dependent on external platforms. This choice ensures that you’re not only operating efficiently but also safeguarding your financial future.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Say goodbye to account freezes and hello to instant payment processing.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
